ideas.title: Football with the sun, take 3: the first kick
ideas.critique: This fixes what the last take was missing: an actual kick, shadows swinging all at once, and the sea lit teal from inside. Those are real light events only a tracer shows. But it is still the same falling-sun-on-the-meadow film, and the kick is scripted. Most of its credit is already spent.

ideas.title: Lighthouse statues
ideas.critique: A beam that sweeps the island and is also the rule of a game is a strong pairing: the light decides who loses, and the player can play it. A lighthouse and a playground game are both predictable pieces, so the twist only lands if the beam is the star of the traced night shot.

ideas.title: Glass rain
ideas.critique: Hundreds of falling lenses throwing real caustic dots is something only a path tracer can do, and friends chasing light like cats gives it life. The risk is that the dots are noisy or too faint at few samples, and the flower payoff is a stock reward.

ideas.title: The sea forgets to be water
ideas.critique: A reflection that stops obeying is uncanny, and a mirror sea shows off the tracer. The danger is that it becomes a second set of creatures painted under a flat plane, and the gag lives or dies on how clearly the reflection's betrayal reads in the shot.

ideas.title: Weight swap minute
ideas.critique: It is one more timed island-wide physics rule acted out by the crowd, the island's most worn form. Ground that stays dented and a pig pulled down by its tail are nice touches, but the shape is familiar.

ideas.title: Low tide treasure
ideas.critique: Digging up the island's own lost things has charm, and a view from the dry seabed is a fresh angle. It is still a sea-level event with a scripted scramble, close to the flood and tilt posts, and the finds are props.

ideas.title: The colour-eating cloud
ideas.critique: This is the roaming patch that changes how things look again, with tag added on. Being sung back to colour by two others is the only new mechanism, and the grey zone itself is a repeat.

ideas.title: Snow globe shake
ideas.critique: A glass dome with refraction and sloshing water could be a striking traced picture, but at its core it is shaking the whole island and throwing everyone, which comes close to the tilt and seesaw posts. Snow globes are also an obvious image.

ideas.title: Lumi juggles
ideas.critique: A juggling bird with no arms works Lumi's body and gives slapstick with real falling pumpkins. But it is the same close Lumi gag film, the scripted third-try success is predictable, and the clapping ending is stock.

ideas.title: The island snores
ideas.critique: Terrain that breathes and answers a player's jump is a way things move that the island never had, and the night mood suits it. It still belongs to the family of the island moving as one body (seesaw, drift, tilt), and the everybody-rolls-off payoff echoes the tip-over.
